g.text: From a Blank Note to Verified Model Content
No type is demanded here. A title is a whole note.

a.title: arch://a_write
a.text: Write a title on a new note

a.title: arch://a_link
a.text: Drag a link to another note

a.title: arch://d_exists
a.text: Does the other end already exist in the model??

g.text: Nothing is checked until both ends reach the level relationships key on. Verification is timely, not nagging.

a.title: arch://a_narrow
a.text: Narrow a level at a time: domain, type, specialization

a.title: arch://a_select
a.text: Select a coherent set; choose where it lands

g.text: Lifting does not empty the scratchpad. The thinking around what was lifted is what would otherwise be lost.

a.title: arch://a_keep
a.text: Keep thinking: the notes are still there

a.title: arch://a_search
a.text: Search the frame for what already exists

g.text: A refusal blocks. A narrowing by a specialization only warns.

a.title: arch://a_refuse
a.text: Offer to reverse the link, change a type, or remove it

a.title: arch://a_bind
a.text: Bind the note to that element

a.title: arch://a_verify
a.text: Check the link against the meta-ontology

a.title: arch://d_permitted
a.text: Does the meta-ontology permit this link??

a.title: arch://a_preflight
a.text: Report what would be created, skipped and refused

a.title: arch://a_write_model
a.text: Write entities and connections in one transaction

a.title: arch://a_record
a.text: Record on each note what it became
